name: Cord 812 SC Phaeton 1937
description:
1937 Cord 812 Supercharged Phaeton, Gordon Buehrig's front-wheel-drive 'coffin nose'. Lycoming V8, 288.6 cu in, Schwitzer-Cummins centrifugal supercharger: 170 bhp at 3500 rpm, 260 lb-ft at 2200. Four-speed gearbox ahead of the engine with the Bendix Electric Hand pre-selector, independent front suspension on trailing arms, Lockheed hydraulic drums, 6.50-16 whitewalls under full chrome wheel covers. The first American car with disappearing headlamps: they rise from the fenders when the lights go on.

Engine-turned instrument panel with working speedometer, tachometer, fuel and temperature gauges, chrome flex exhaust pipes, wrap-round louvres, the supercharger's whine. Opening front-hinged doors, cowl wipers, pedals, pre-selector and handbrake from period photos, and the front-drive running gear, rear axle and leaf springs moving with the wheels. Skins in the 1937 Cord colours with their trim.

3D model: "1937 Cord 812 SC Phaeton" by annaandrei (https://sketchfab.com/annaandrei), CC BY 4.0 - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/1937-cord-812-sc-phaeton-f9b937406b9e45cc9004bfbcb9b7514f - modified by Street Corsa Mods.
Port, rebuild, physics, engine sound, gauges and skins: Street Corsa Mods - https://streetcorsamods.com/
Improve it: https://sourceforge.net/p/streetcorsa-mods/cord-812-phaeton-1937/
